en.title: Domain Events Are Not Integration Events: Two Kinds of Events in a .NET App
en.subtitle: A domain event is handled in-process, often before the commit. An integration event is a public contract that must leave only after the commit, and an outbox is how you get it there.

ar-EG.title: الـ domain events مش integration events: نوعين events في أي app بالـ .NET
ar-EG.subtitle: الـ domain event بيتعالج جوه نفس الـ process، وغالبًا قبل الـ commit. أما الـ integration event فهو contract عام لازم يخرج بعد الـ commit بس، والـ outbox هو الطريقة اللي توصّله بيها.
